reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 18. Nay or No: 18. Not Voting: 3. Present or other: 1. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
On #VeteransDay, we honor the courage and sacrifice of our heroes in uniform.

We must ensure Veterans and their families receive the support they’ve earned and deserve. Because just as we leave no soldier behind on the battlefield, we leave no Veteran behind when they come home.

Last night, I had the pleasure of joining GLIDE for its Holiday Jam with the legendary @MsPattiPatti.

It was an honor to receive the Lizzie Glide Spirit Award from a community that carries on Lizzie’s legacy of serving our San Francisco neighbors with love. https://t.co/gQtkh3hNWf

When I came to Congress in 1987, there were only twelve Democratic women. We made it our mission to change that.

Today, we celebrate the election of more than 100 Democratic women to the House — a tremendous joy and source of pride.

When women succeed, America succeeds!
Speaker Hakeem Jeffries.

Happy Election Day, California! Make your voice heard and cast your ballot.

Find your polling place or a ballot drop box below ⬇️
https://t.co/jHCSCo1GnB

All season long, the @Valkyries have made our City proud. From opening night to the WNBA Finals, they’ve shown us what it means to soar. 

Good luck to our warriors of Boohalla as they take the court tonight looking to make history.

The Golden State is rooting for you! https://t.co/kmoIMocfG6

Trump promised to lower costs on Day One.

He lied. 

Inflation is accelerating, tariffs are driving up prices and working families are paying the price while Trump and his billionaire friends cash in.

Today, we sadly mourn the loss of Dolores Huerta, a leader in the American labor movement and a champion for civil rights.

Dolores was a dear friend whose rallying cry, “Sí se puede,” inspired generations of Americans to believe in the power of collective action. https://t.co/YeeL890slv

As we honor their memory, we commit ourselves to confronting the rising tide of antisemitism, rejecting hatred and ensuring every American is safe to worship in peace.

Children should never have to fear for their lives in a classroom.

Social Security checks can’t keep up with Trumpflation.

Trump’s illegal war and reckless tariffs are driving up bills for seniors on fixed incomes.

Unlike Republicans, House Democrats will fight to lower costs and ensure that Americans can retire with dignity.

His illegal war in Iran and his reckless tariffs are driving up prices while spineless Republicans in Congress rubber-stamp his disastrous agenda. https://t.co/eOnq7uATo4

On #IndigenousPeoplesDay, we celebrate the rich cultures and enduring contributions of Indigenous peoples.

Today and every day, we reaffirm our respect for Tribal sovereignty and our commitment to health care, education and economic opportunity for all Tribal communities.

Congratulations to our Golden State Valkyries on advancing to the WNBA Finals!

In just their second season, the @Valkyries have made history and captured the hearts of fans across San Francisco and the Bay Area.

Our City is cheering you on!

Pete Hegseth wants to turn an execution into a public spectacle for Americans and the world to watch.

He dishonors both our nation and the position he holds. He is beyond unfit to lead the brave men and women of our Armed Forces.

He must go.

Three years ago, the world watched Hamas carry out a horrific and heinous terrorist attack on Israel.

Today, we mourn those murdered in the deadliest attack on Jews since the Holocaust and stand with the survivors and families whose lives were forever changed.

The bond between the United States and Taiwan is strong, and Congress’ commitment to the Taiwanese people and their freedom remains steadfast. https://t.co/x11WrsOt5B

The words of an American President weigh a ton. He must not be frivolous with the weight of his office.

Donald Trump has gone beyond the pale saying Iran can “take out” Los Angeles and San Diego.

How could he say the slaughter of Americans is a "small price to pay"?

Today’s dismal jobs report once again shows that Trump’s economy is better at producing problems than paychecks.

Instead of working to lower costs, Republicans have sent Congress home—skipping town just as working families need relief the most.

Today, provisions of the President’s Big Ugly Bill take effect that cut Medicaid and eliminate funding for SNAP, threatening the food assistance and health care that millions of Americans depend on. 

The President and his sycophants in Congress gleefully cheered these cuts—but

At a time when working families are struggling to make ends meet, the President is using their hard-earned tax dollars to air ads celebrating himself.

Trump’s need to feed his insatiable ego surprises no one, but making the American people pay for it is a disgrace.

It was an honor to receive special recognition from the @PreventCancer Foundation’s Congressional Families Program yesterday.

Cancer touches every family, and I’m grateful to Lisa McGovern for bringing us together across party lines to help prevent it or catch it early. https://t.co/dfkVyx4igS

It was a joy to cheer on the women of Congress and the press corps at the Congressional Women’s Softball Game yesterday.

Above all, the evening was a wonderful chance to stand with young adults facing breast cancer and support the Young Survival Coalition’s vital work. https://t.co/9E6jzbMAIA

It was a pleasure to celebrate Senator Barbara Mikulski’s 90th birthday today.

From Baltimore’s neighborhoods to the halls of Congress, Barbara has been a tireless champion for working families and an inspiration to generations of women in public service. https://t.co/owMucUFRPD

16 years ago, the ACA’s Patient’s Bill of Rights took effect—ending lifetime coverage limits, protecting children with pre-existing conditions and safeguarding access to care.

Contrary to the Trump Administration's beliefs, no one should lose coverage when they need it most.

“Of all the forms of inequality, injustice in health is the most shocking and the most inhuman because it often results in death.” —Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.

The Trump Administration's shameless decision to rip away health insurance from thousands will leave working families https://t.co/ZSovFdvvGx

They told us “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” was essential to protecting our military.

They were wrong.

Fifteen years after tossing that discriminatory policy into the dustbin of history where it belongs, we know the truth: discrimination has never made America safer—and it never will. https://t.co/V1BtqnrC0K

Freedom of the press is a right guaranteed by the First Amendment—not granted at the pleasure of the President.

The free press represents the people, and Trump doesn’t get to decide that they can’t cover his presidency because he doesn’t approve of their reporting.

posts.text:
It was a pleasure to meet with advocates from @AmericaforUA this week to discuss how Congress can help bring home the Ukrainian children who were cruelly abducted by Russia.

Families are still waiting to bring their children home—and the world must not look away. https://t.co/WQImYNDGGW

On #ConstitutionDay, we honor our Founders’ vision and the promise of our Constitution: a government of, by and for the people.

Each generation has a sacred responsibility to protect our democracy and uphold the values Americans have fought to protect.

The President’s reckless war in Iran is costing taxpayers billions, while skyrocketing prices make everyday life more expensive for working families.

Trump said we couldn’t afford to lower costs—but he has no problem finding $38 billion for his war of choice.

As working families struggle to make ends meet, House Republicans are canceling multiple weeks of work for themselves.

The American people don't have the luxury of taking vacations from skyrocketing grocery bills, rent or health care costs.

Republicans need to get back to work.

32 years ago, the Violence Against Women Act became law, strengthening our nation’s commitment to justice.

Today, we once again commit to building on that progress until every woman can live free from violence and fear—with the safety, dignity and respect they deserve.
